text:
1844 is a leap year (divisible by 4, not a century year unless divisible by 400).  
From 1844-10-21, remaining days in October: 31 - 21 = 10 days.  
261 - 10 = 251 days left after October.  

November 1844: 30 days → 251 - 30 = 221  
December 1844: 31 days → 221 - 31 = 190  
January 1845: 31 days → 190 - 31 = 159  
February 1845: 28 days (1845 not leap) → 159 - 28 = 131  
March 1845: 31 days → 131 - 31 = 100  
April 1845: 30 days → 100 - 30 = 70  
May 1845: 31 days → 70 - 31 = 39  
June 1845: 30 days → 39 - 30 = 9  

July 1845: 9 days into July → 1845-07-09.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1845-07-09
